newsitem.title: USA: Emerson says Cargil to sell Emerson products.
newsitem.headline: Emerson says Cargil to sell Emerson products.

text.p: Emerson Radio Corp said on Thursday that it reached an agreement for Cargil International to sell Emerson Radio branded products in the Caribbean as well as in Central and South America.
Under the terms, Cargil will license the Emerson trademark and logo for use in the markets over a five-year period.
Cargil agreed to source no less than 75 percent of the value of such products through Emerson's existing Hong Kong sourcing and supply operation, Emerson said.
The five-year licensing and supply agreement for central and Latin american market is subject to renewal.
Cargil has agreed to assume all costs and expenses of purchasing product and marketing, sales and support costs associated with the sale of products.
Emerson said it plans to maximize the value of its assets and expertise while limiting or eliminating working capital exposure and risks.
The arrangement will allow Cargil to benefit from Emerson's economies of scale in its Hong Kong sourcing and supply operation.
